Two Suspected Drug Smugglers Arrested in Mahasamund with Large Ganja Seizure

Police in Mahasamund have arrested two suspected drug smugglers and seized a large quantity of ganja. One report states 38 lakh rupees worth of contraband was recovered, while another reports the seizure to be worth 48.95 lakh rupees. The supply originated from Maharashtra.
